body:
The merge-ask check accepted supplied gate text with no external review round count. It now reuses the existing summary rule outside fenced blocks and holds without writing an ask record when the count is missing or malformed. Zero and counts with detail pass; both `question` forms keep their existing behavior.

Stacked on #766. Base branch: `spacedock-ensign/second-round-prompts-a-step-back` (`6cea11d5ce4c8e3dc0d6711f13233b211fd94668`). Candidate: `2b471f41497483b32397a8286e494c3797ae9ac1`.

ADR 0051 records the Captain's accepted boundary: this checks supplied text at the merge ask, and does not force a check before binding or read the bound briefing. Workflow instructions, their word budget and versions have no changes relative to the stacked base.

Validation:
- Delivery gate suite: 124 tests passed; three disposable-source mutations each failed their target assertion with `python3 -B` and cleared caches.
- Seven supplied briefing texts from state `99e8bb36` replayed: the four missing counts change from pass to hold; the other three results stay unchanged. Provider and task-history inputs are fixtures in this replay.
- Skill lint, ADR lint (requiring 0051), number guards and comment ratio passed. Added comments are 2.6%, below the 5% maximum.
- All 26 commands from the CI job passed locally, including both Spacedock integration scripts. The Spacedock dispatch run uses installed binary 0.27.2 with installed plugin source 0.27.3; DNS/connector failure prevented fetching CI-pinned source `4d158a484ec73e184861067f8ed1e20087fdc26a`.

Pending FO delivery checks: real Draft PR runs for acceptance criterion 4, hosted CI and RoboRev. The local wrapper returned exit 3: `incomplete: the roborev daemon is not running`. CI cost per PR was not measured; workflow triggers are unchanged.

RoboRev: run by FO: `clean on 2b471f414; evidence=roborev:1402`.
